title: A Veil for the Crown
author: Elodie Sterling
blurb: Noor Quintana, a beast-speaker hiding a forbidden gift, knows every smuggler's road through the Thornfell mountains. Then a dying stranger presses a map into unwilling hands — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must steal back a soul sold to the court beneath the mountain, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
